ns2:section.sectionText: Topic:Social Stratification and Inequality The main classical and modern explanations of the causes of social, economic and political inequality. Key issues: the consequences of inequality for individuals and groups; the relative importance of economic, political and social forces in creating and sustaining inequality; class consciousness; the significance of race, ethnicity and gender; and the use of social policy to mitigate inequality. Cases range from technologically simple groups, the Indian caste system, and the U.S. and other societies in modern times.
